text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The Osaka Hai is here. Oguri Cap won't be racing today because of an injury, but Super Creek, who Yaeno Muteki raced at the Kikuka Sho, is running.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Yaeno is looking to build her reputation in this. She promises to light her obsession while keeping both blaze fierce and water still in perfect balance.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She boasts that the audience will only have eyes for her.
